tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lha sum cu rtsa bdun gyi dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i thabs bde ba bskyed ma zhes bya ba bzhugs/
༄༅/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lha sum cu rtsa bdun gyi dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i thabs bde ba bskyed ma zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lha sum cu rtsa bdun gyi dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i thabs bde ba bskyed ma zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo gu ru badz+ra yo gi ni tsa rā ṇa ya/ mtha' dag rgyal ba kun gyi bde bskyed yum/ /li khri'i mdangs 'phrog 'jo sgeg lang tsho can/ /mtshar sdug 'od 'bar rab drag dpa' mo'i sku/ /rdo rje btsun mos bdag la dges par mdzod/ /'dir rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lha sum cu rtsa bdun gyi dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs nyams su blang bar 'dod pas/ bde ba'i brtan la kha nub tu phyogs nas/ skyabs sems rdo rje sems pa'i sgom bzlas rnams sngon du gtang nas/ bā ra hi ā haṃ/ rang skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur/ oṃ a ā nas/ aṃ aḥ ka kha nas/ ha k+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa lan gsum/ ā li kā li'i 'phreng ba 'od zer lnga ldan/ lte bar lan gsum g.yon skor du 'khyil ba/ de las 'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ 'gegs rnams bcom ste/ slar yang lte ba'i sngags 'phreng la thim/ rang gi mgo bo/ lte ba/ mgrin pa/ long bu/ snying kha/ spyi gtsug rnams su rim pas/ gzugs kyi phung po oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po/ tshor ba'i phung po aṃ las rdo rje nyi ma ser po/ 'du shes kyi phung po hrīḥlas pad+ma gar dbang dmar po/ 'du byed kyi phung po ho la rdo rje rgyal po ljang khu/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po hūm̐ las rdo rje sems pa dkar po/ phung po lnga char gyi ngo bo hi las he ru ka nag po/ mig 'bras/ rna ba'i khung*/ sna phug /lce'i rtsa ba/ dpral ba/ snying kha rnams su/ rim pas/ mig oṃ las gti mug rdo rje dkar po/ rna ba hūm̐ las zhe sdang rdo rje nag po/ rna tram̐ las phrag dog rdo rje ser po/ lce a las 'dod chags rdo rje dmar po/ dpral bar kham̐ las ser sna rdo rje ljang khu/ snying khar hūm̐ las dbang phyug rdo rje dmar po/ lte ba/ snying kha/ mgrin pa/ dpral ba/ gsang gnas rnams su rim pas/ sa khams lam̐ las ltung byed ma ser mo/ chu khams yam̐ las gsod byed ma nag mo/

me khams pam̐ las 'gugs byed ma dmar mo/ rlung khams tam̐ las gar dbang ma ljang khu/ kha khams kham̐ las pad+ma drwa ba can ma dud kha rnams su gyur/ 'di dag zhal phyag rgyas par bsgom par 'dod na/ lū hi pa'i 'grel pa shes rab bsrung bas mdzad pa ltar shes par bya/ bsdu na yab rnams rdo rje dril bu dang*/ yum rnams gri thod dang 'dzin pa'o/ / rang gi snying khar pam̐ las pad+ma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du baṃ yig dmar po/ de'i 'od kyi nang gi rnyog pa bsal te/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor sangs rgyas byang chub sems pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid sogs dang*/ stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ khams gsum pa yi ngo bo nyid/ /skal pa'i me bzhin gzi brjid 'bar/ /rdo rje phag mo la 'dud do/ /oṃ bī ni badz+ri ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa nas/ oṃ dharma dha tu badz+rī ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ces pa'i mthar rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes gsang ba'i mchod pas mchod/ yum gyi rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ bdag gis sdig pa bgyis par gyur pa ma lus rnams/ khyed rnams kun gyi mngon du so sor bshags par bgyi/ bla ma la sogs rnams kyis bsod rnams bgyis pa gang*/ de rnams ma lus kun la rjes su yi rang ngo*/ /bya ba byas pa byed par 'gyur ba gang dag gi /dge ba des ni sems can ma lus rgyal bar smon/ /dkon mchog gsum la nges par yang dag skyabs su mchi/ /'gro ba bde la 'gor phyir chos kyi rgyal por gyur/ / rgyal ba rnams kyi lam la yang dag gnas par bgyi/ /mgon po bzhes shig bdag gi lus 'di dbul lags kyi/ /sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig / ces sogs/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bya/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/

oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rang sems na da'i rnam par langs nas nam mkhar gnas par bsam/ 'og tu yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam/ de'i steng du raṃ las mo'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ de'i steng du bam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i steng du lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/ de'i steng du sum̐ las rin po che ri rab sna bzhi las grub pa/ sdigs mdzug skor zhing se gol gdab pa'i mtshams rngam phyogs bzhir byed bzhin du/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa nas/ bir+yā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa zhes pa'i bar brjod/ sngags kyi 'od zer las grub pa'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur gla re/ mda'i drwa ba ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i bsru ba'i 'khor lo gyur/ oṃ me bhi ni badz+ṝ bha wa ban+dha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pra ka ra hūm̐ pam̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pañtsa ra hūm̐ yam̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra bi rā na hūm̐ kham̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dzā la tram̐ tram̐ tram̐/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lar ka hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ slar yang phyogs mtshams brgyad du mtshams rngam dang bcas pa'i/ oṃ sum+bha sogs zhal bzhi pa'i sngags lan gnyis brjod/ sngags kyi 'od zer las byung ba'i sgo mtshams ma brgyad kha dog so sor nges pa can/ tho ba dang phur bu thogs pa spros phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams phyogs skyong bcu'i rnam par bkug ste/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i khron pa rnams su bcug /de rnams kyi spyi bor phur bus btab/ oṃ gha gha sogs phur bu'i spyi bor tho bas brdungs/ oṃ badz+ra mut+ga ra sogs/ bgegs rnams phur bus btab pas 'od gsal la thib par 'gyur/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su chos 'byung dkar po'i nang du/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje la gnas pa'i/ bh+rūm̐ las rnam par snang mdzad shes rab ma dang bcas pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las/

rin po chen sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang*/ gru bzhi/ sgo bzhi/ rtsigs pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ pha gu dang*/ bre phul dang*/ gser gyi snam bu dang*/ dra phyed dang*/ shar bu dang*/ zla yab dang*/ bzung ma rnams dang bcas pa'i kha khyer te/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ sgo bzhi'i mdun du ka bas steg pa'i rta babs kyis mdzes pa/ nang gi lha rnams shar dkar/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser/ mtshams rnams su bum pa brgyad dang bcas pa/ dbus sngo ba'i steng du sku'i 'khor lo dkar po/ rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud la 'khor lo'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa/ de'i lte bar gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ mu khyud la pad+ma'i 'phreng bas mdzes pa de'i lte bar thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po/ brtsebs brgyad pa mu khyud la rdo rje'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i lte bar paṃ las bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ sdong bu cung zad dang bcas pa/ mu khyud la gri gug gi 'phreng bas bskor ba/ steng thog rim par phug pa'i dbus phyur gur gyur pa/ nang gi lha'i gnas rnams su nyi ma'i gdan sum cu rtsa gsum mo/ /gzhal med khang gi phyi rol mchod pa'i bkod pa thams cad dang bcas shing*/ pad 'dab kyi khor yug bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i phyi rol/ dur khrod chen po brgyad dang*/ phyogs skyong ba dang*/ zhing skyong ba dang*/ shing dang*/ me dang*/ sprin dang*/ chu dang*/ ri dang*/ mchod rten dang*/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis yongs su khyab pa'o/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ a ā nas/ aṃ āḥ phrag gnyis las zla ba/ de'i steng du ka kha nas/ ha k+ṣa/ ḍa ḍha/ da dha ya la/ khrag gnyis zhu ba las/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de gnyis kyi bar du/ baṃ las rdo rje'i lte bar bam̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas/

slar 'dus ste bam̐ la thim/ de thams cad yongs su gyur pa las/ lha thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ sku mdog pad+ma ra ga ltar dmar ba/ lo bcu drug lon pa ltar lang tsho la bab cing*/ skal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/ drag mo chen mo rjes chags bde ba'i nyams kyi myos pa'i sku/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis dmar zhing bkra la/ zlum pa'i spyan gsum g.yo ba/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug mthur tu sdigs shing*/ sdang ba dang gdug pa thams cad 'joms pa/ g.yon pa thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng gi phyogs su bzung nas zhal du gsol ba/ mchan khung g.yon par kha ṭ+wāṃ ga thabs kyi rang bzhin can la/ ḍā ma ru dang*/ dril bu g.yer kha dang 'phan lce gsum pa rnams 'phyang bzhin du bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur grol ba/ zhal rnam par 'gyur zhing mche ba rtsigs pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga yi dbu brgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu rus pa'i brgyan lngas brgyan pa/ dmar chen gyi gtung bas myos shing*/ si ha la'i rgyun 'bab pa/ zhabs g.yon brkum pas 'jigs byed nag po dang*/ g.yas brkyang pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo mnan pa ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ / snying po dang nye snying tshar gcig brjod do/ / 'dab ma brgyad la/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ mtshams bzhir khu ba dang*/ khrag dang*/ bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ sgron ma lngas gang ba'i thod pa bzhi'o/ /de'i phyi rol du/ thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs su li ra ma lar sar rab gtum ma/ byang rtsibs dza lan+dha rar gtum mig ma/ nub phyogs o ḍi ya nar 'od ldan ma/ lho phyogs ar gu tar ṇa chen ma/ shar lho gau dha ni rir dpa' bo'i blo ma/ lho nub rasmi shwa rar mi'u thung ma/

nub byang dwe ko ru laṅka'i dbang phyug ma/ byang shar ma la bar shing grib ma ste thams cad kyang sku mdog sngon po/ de'i phyi rol gsung gi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs ka ma ru par sa bsrung ma/ byang rtsibs o ṭir 'jigs byed chen mo/ nub phyogs tri sha ku ner rlung gi shugs can ma/ lho rtsibs ko sa lar chang 'thung ma/ shar lho ka ling kar sngo sangs lha mo/ lho nub lam+bha kar shin tu bzang mo/ nub byang kañtsi ra ta na ma/ byang shar gi ma la yar bya gdong ma ste thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar mo'o/ /de'i phyi rol du sku'i 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs dre ta pu rir 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ byang rtsibs gri hā de bar khaṇ+ḍa ro hi/ nub phyogs so so ras ṭar shon ṭi ni/ lho phyogs su bar na di par 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ shar lho na ga rar shin tu dpa' mo/ lho nub sin+dhur pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug /nub byang ma hur rnam par snang mdzad/ byang shar ku mu tar brtson 'grus chen mo ste/ thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar mo'o/ /dam tshig gi 'khor lo'i/ shar sgor khwa gdong ma nag mo/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya ma g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ de thams cad mo'i gzugs can zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas gnyis na gri gug dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis na thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing skra grol ba/ rdo rje'i 'phreng bas dbu la brgyan cing*/ mi mgo'i cod pan can dang do shal can/ g.yas rkyang gi stabs kyi gnas pas dngos grub thams cad stsol ba/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad ni ro'i gdan la gnas pa'o/ / yang na gzhan 'dra ba la/

ma mo bcu gnyis rnams phyag dang po gnyis ḍā ma ru dang*/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /lhag ma gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin par byas kyang rung ngo*/ / oṃ ḍā ki nī nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pa nas/ oṃ ya ma ma tha nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyi bar rnams long skabs yod cing spro ba'i tshe/tshar gcig brjod par bya'o/ / rkang mthil rlung*/ gsum mdo me/ lto ba chu/ snying kha sa/ rgal tshigs ri rab/ lus ngag yid gsum 'khor lo gsum/ lus 'dom gang grub bzhi/ gzhal med khang gru bzhi/ rkang brgyad ni ka ba brgyad/ spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab so gnyis pad+ma/ der rgyu ba'i rlung dang thig le dbyangs dang gsal byed kyi ngo bo'o/ /snying kha nas 'byung ba rgyu ba'i rtsa rnams/ lam̐ tam̐ pam̐ mam̐ las snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi/ mchod pa'i rtsa bzhi la thod pa bzhi/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su pu dza o a/ gau ra de ma/ ka o tri ko /ka la ka hi/ pre grib so so su/ na si ma ku rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ spyi bor rab gtum ma/ spyi gtsug tu gtum mig ma/ rna ba g.yas su 'od ldan ma/ ltag par sna chen ma/ rna ba g.yon du dpa' bo'i blo ma/ smin mtshams su mi thung ma/ mig gnyis su lang ka'i dbang phyug ma/ dpung pa gnyis su shing grib ma mchan khung gnyis su sa bsrung ma/ nu ma gnyis su 'jigs byed chen mo/ lte bar rlung shugs ma/ rna rtser chang 'thung ma/ khar sngo sangs lha mo/ mgrin par shin tu bzang mo/ snying khar ra na ma/ 'bras bur bya gdong ma/ mtshan ma la 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ rla gnyis su shon ḍi ni/ byin pa gnyis su 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ sor mo brgyad la shin tu dpa' mo/ bol gong gnyis su stobs chen ma/ mthe bong gnyis su 'khor lo ras bsgyur ma/ dpus mo gnyis la brtson 'grus chen mo/ lce'i rtsa bar khwa gdong ma/ lte bar 'ug gdong ma/ rtags kyi sgor khyi gdong ma/ bshang sgor phag gdong ma/ mdzod pur gshin rje brtan ma/

rna bar pho nya ma/ mig la ba ma/ sna phug tu 'joms ma'o/ / de nas dag pa dran pa ni/ lus dang tshor bas chos dang zhes pa nas/ 'joms ma bzhi'o/ / zhes pa'i bar nag po pa dang 'dra/ rang gi mig tu bh+rūm̐/ rna bar hūm̐/ sna la kham̐/ lce la āḥ dpral bar ham̐/ snying khar ha/ lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo nas tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo bar/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ snying kha'i dbus su pad nyi'i steng du/ rdo rje'i lte bar bam̐/ thugs kha'i 'od zer gyi ye shes kyi 'khor lo dang*/ dbang gi lha mchod pa'i lha mo dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ phaiṃ/ oṃ bī ni badz+ri ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa sogs kyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes dbang gi lha rnams la gsol ba btab pas/ j-i ltar ltams pa tsam gyi ni/ / zhes pa nas/ shrī ye hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing thod pa bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso mo la rdo rje sems pa/ bde chen 'khor lo pa la rin 'byung*/ thugs 'khor pa la mi bskyod pa/ gsung 'khor pa la 'od dpag med/ sku 'khor pa la rnam snang*/ dam tshig 'khor pa la don grub kyi dbu brgyan/ ar+ghaṃ

nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis rlabs la/ rdor 'dzin phag mo in+d+ra bhu ti dang*/ /dpal mo ni ru pa dang ḍom bi pa/ /ngo mtshar rdo rje gar bha ri pa dang*/ /ga ga dha ra rab dga'i rdo rje dang*/ /dpal 'dzin ye shes rdo rje de bzhin du/ khrag 'thung rdo rje lhan skyes rdo rje dang*/ /chos dbang bdud las rgyal dang sa 'dzin zhabs/ /dpa' mo dpal gyi bshes gnyen chos grags dang*/ /rin chen grags pa nags rin grags 'byung zhabs/ /gzhon nu dkon mchog gzhon du chos drug dang*/ /grol mchog zhabs dang rtsa ba'i bla ma'i mchod/ / yang na 'khrul spong gi dbang gi brgyud pa ltar ram/ 'phreng ba'i brgyud pa ltar byas kyang rung*/ u ma pa ti dad da nas brgyud pa/ rwa lo tsā ba chos rab las byung ba'i lugs kyang*/ 'di dang mtshungs pa kho na yin mod kyi/ brgyud pa'i rim pa de nyid kho bos ma gnos so/ /snying po dang lha rnams kyi sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum rtags pas phul/ man ngag ltar rjes chags kyi rnal 'byor sgoms te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ yum gyi rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas pa'i sgo nas/ 'khor lo'i dmigs pa'i spro bsdu'i dmigs pa gsal btab nas/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa ti badz+ra ba ra hi zhes sogs rtsa ba'i sngags dang*/ lha so so'i mtshan sngags ci 'grub du bzla zhing*/ mdor bsdus pa'i tshe/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra bar+ṇa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa zhes pa nye snying dang*/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā zhes pas snying po ste/ de dag ci 'grub du bzla'o/ /thun bsdu ba'i tshe/ rang gi snying kha'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyi snang ba thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor sbyangs/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor la thim/ dkyil 'khor yang rim pas bam̐ yig la thim/ bam̐ yang 'od gsal du zhugs/

slar yang rang nyid rdo rje btsun mo'i rnam par langs ta ེ/ go chas brgyas btab la mthun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug go /rdzogs pa'i rim pa sgom par 'dod na bzlas pa'i mthar bya'o/ /gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ phyogs skyong spyan 'dren gyi sngags rnams bor nas/ sdom 'byung gi gtor chog de kho nas bya ba yin pas/ sgrub thabs snying po las kyang snying por gyur par shes par bya'o/ /'di nyid kyi lag mchod dang phyi rol mchod pa sogs kyang*/ gzhan du 'bri bar gyur bas 'dir ma bshad do/ /dpal mthu stobs kyi mgon po bir wa pa gang las mchog gi gnas brnyes pa'i lam yang 'di las gzhan du mi bsam mo zhes tshad dang ldan pa'i bla ma dag gsung ngo*/ / grub mchog stong gi gshegs pa'i lam yang por/ /blo gros shing rtas nye bar 'tsho ba bdag /rdo rje btsun mos rtag tu rjes bzung nas/ /he ru ka dpal bdag po'i sar 'god shog /ces pa rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lha sum cu rtsa bdun gyi dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i thabs bde ba bskyed ma zhes bya ba/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo sum cu pa la gser mdog can du sbyar ba'o/ /bkra shis// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lha sum cu rtsa bdun gyi dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i thabs bde ba bskyed ma zhes bya ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 394 -- PAGE 395 -- PAGE 386 -
